plugins.name: shopify-insight-report
plugins.description: Builds a merchant-facing insight report from a store's own Shopify analytics (ShopifyQL): finds when a metric broke, which funnel step and segment moved, and whether a suspected change (theme publish, app install, checkout or shipping change, price, discount, campaign, or A/B test) caused it. Delivers a verdict-first HTML report the merchant can re-run query by query. Works with a Shopify MCP, a read-only access token, or CSV exports from the ShopifyQL editor.
